The employer/reporting-unit name as stated by the publisher for this row. This is a publisher-reported employer name, not a registrar-stated legal name; it is not unique and may coincide with a corporate group name.
The employer size band stated by the publisher for the reporting employer, kept as the publisher's band label rather than an exact headcount. Values are the WGEA bands as written in the source.
The publisher's sector classification for the reporting employer (e.g. Private, Public). This is a WGEA sector classification, not a legal form and not an ANZSIC industry.

The ANZSIC Division name stated by the publisher for the employer (e.g. Transport, Postal and Warehousing). Kept as the publisher's division label. Same ANZSIC 2006 scheme as dyn.workforce.anzsic_class, at the coarser division level; neither is crosswalked to a code.

The ANZSIC Class name stated by the publisher for the employer (e.g. Computer System Design and Related Services). Kept as the publisher's class label. Same ANZSIC 2006 scheme as dyn.workforce.anzsic_division, at the finer class level; neither is crosswalked to a code.
Share of the employer's total workforce who are women, as a proportion (0-1) stated by the publisher for the reporting period.
Share of women (0-1) in a named pay quartile of the employer's workforce, as stated by the publisher for the reporting period. The quartile is identified by the quartile qualifier.

Average total remuneration in dollars for a named pay quartile of the employer's workforce, as stated by the publisher for the reporting period. This is remuneration, not revenue or business income. Currency is inferred as AUD from the Australian federal publisher; the source header states only '($)'.

Average total remuneration in dollars across the employer's total workforce, as stated by the publisher for the reporting period. Remuneration, not revenue or business income. Currency is inferred as AUD from the Australian federal publisher; the source header states only '($)'.

Gender pay gap as a proportion (0-1, may be negative) stated by the publisher for the reporting period, identified by the remuneration basis (base salary or total remuneration) and the statistic (average or median) qualifiers. A derived gap measure, not a pay level. The publisher already expresses the gap as a proportion despite the '(%)' header (observed values like 0.044, 0.221); a future percent-formatted value would need a percent-to-proportion step.

Columns ['ip_right_type']; role ip_application; ip_right_type is the published IP right family; mapped to the new ip_application right_type enum, with unlisted families falling to 'other' rather than being guessed.

Columns ['application_number']; role ip_application; application_number is the IP Australia application identifier; kept as published and qualified by right_type, not treated as a party or company identifier.
Columns ['party_id']; role ip_party; party_id is the IP Australia party identifier; kept as a party attribute and never treated as or converted into an ABN.

Columns ['party_name']; role ip_party; party_name is the published party name; it may be an organisation, a personal name or a numeric-looking string, so it is kept as a party name and not promoted to a business legal name. Marked personal_data=always because the population mixes individuals.

Columns ['party_type']; role ip_party; party_type distinguishes organisation and individual parties; mapped to the party kind enum with unknown for unlisted values, and never used to infer sole trader or company legal form.
Columns ['party_role_category']; role ip_party; party_role_category is the coarse published role level; kept distinct from the finer party_role and not collapsed into it.

Columns ['party_role']; role ip_party; party_role is the finer published role (patentee, applicant, agent, opponent_agent); applicant, patentee and agent roles are not interchangeable and are kept as published.

Columns ['is_current']; role ip_party; is_current is a party-activity currency flag; mapped to the party concept, not to entity.status, because it does not establish company status or IP right enforceability.
Columns ['is_founding']; role ip_party; is_founding is a supplied party-activity attribute; kept as a party flag and explicitly not read as company founding or incorporation evidence.

Columns ['abn']; role ip_party; abn is an optional party attribute, blank in most sampled rows; checksum-validated with the abn transform and never derived from party_id or party_name. Owned by ip_party because the party may be an individual or agent, not necessarily the subject business.

Columns ['state_code']; role ip_party; state_code is the raw state/territory code of the party address; kept as published on the party record rather than normalised into the business address.state enum, since it may be non-Australian or blank and is not a jurisdiction of incorporation.

Columns ['post_code']; role ip_party; post_code is a heterogeneous party-address field (e.g. 't6b 3n9', '110044'); kept exactly as recorded on the party record and not normalised through the AU postcode transform.

Columns ['country_code']; role ip_party; country_code is the lower-case country code of the party address; kept as published on the party record and not read as a company jurisdiction of incorporation.

Columns ['effective_from_date']; role subject; effective_from_date dates when the party-activity claim became true; mapped to the generic observation.valid_from facet, not to a business incorporation or licence start date.

Columns ['effective_to_date']; role subject; effective_to_date dates when the party-activity claim stopped being true; mapped to observation.valid_to, where null means still current as far as this source knows. It is not a licence end or business end date.
